content:
We live in an era when digital efficiency is not only desired but required. Because of this, businesses across Australia are turning to innovative solutions to enhance their operations.

For the past 14 years, Virtual Office Angels stands at the forefront, providing only highly skilled professional and specialized virtual assistant services tailored to modern business needs.

Discover how sectors ranging from financial planners, accountants, real estate agents and mortgage brokers to small and medium enterprises can benefit from our expertise to streamline operations, boost customer engagement, and drive significant growth.

5 Business Industries That Can Thrive With Virtual Assistance Services

1.   Financial Planners

In the world of financial planning, accuracy and personal touch go hand in hand. Financial planners know the importance of giving each client the time and detailed advice they deserve.

But, with so many tasks to juggle, it’s easy to get caught up in the paperwork and lose valuable time that could be spent advising clients. That’s where Virtual Office Angels (VOA) steps in.

Virtual financial assistants and support are a game-changer for financial planners. They tackle the time-consuming tasks that can bog down your day.

Imagine the relief of not worrying about setting up meetings because your appointments are organised and scheduled. Or consider the convenience of having a VA do the meticulous insurance research, enter data in your specialised CRMs (ie Midwinter, Xplan, etc) ready to go, so you only need to add your unique insights. It lets you focus more on your clients and less on administrative tasks.

2.    Mortgage and Loans Firms

Every detail matters when processing mortgages and loans. The journey from application to settlement involves numerous steps that require careful handling. These Virtual Mortgage Support Assistants from Virtual Office Angels are highly skilled professionals that make this journey smoother and faster for the firms and their clients. How? By taking on the heavy lifting of data entry, preparing needed documents, entering data into special CRMs (i.e. Connective, Flex, Podium, etc) , assist organise loan structures, speaking with BDMs, etc while ensuring compliance at the same time ready to go and making it easy prior to final submission.

We understand the importance of data security and confidentiality, and our virtual assistants adhere to strict protocols to ensure your information is always protected.

This means that firms will have enough support to process loans faster and more accurately, leaving clients happy and seeking for refinancing. Imagine cutting down customer waiting times and boosting your firm’s reputation for efficiency –  that’s the power Virtual Office Angels brings to your doorstep. 

3.   Accountants and Bookkeepers

For accountants and bookkeepers, precision in financial reporting and compliance is non-negotiable. Virtual Office Angels brings a layer of efficiency and accuracy to these financial professionals through expert remote assistance.

Specialising in highly preferred accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, Saasu, etc. our virtual assistants ensure that financial records are maintained, reports are generated accurately, and compliance with ATO regulatory standards is upheld.

This support allows accountants and bookkeepers to focus on more strategic financial analysis and advisory services, adding excellent value to client relationships.

4.   Real Estate Firms

In the bustling world of real estate, staying on top of everything is critical. This means keeping property listings fresh, answering client questions quickly, and ensuring all the paperwork is in perfect order. Virtual assistants step in to help make all this happen smoothly for real estate agents and firms.

With Virtual Office Angels, real estate professionals can rest assured they have the support they need. Whether they’re ensuring property details catch the eye of the right buyers or helping potential clients get the information they need fast, reliable virtual assistants streamline operations and boost confidence.

5.   Sales and Marketing Agencies

Sales and marketing are all about telling a story that people want to hear, one that makes them eager to buy what you’re selling. Grabbing attention online is crucial, where everyone is constantly bombarded with information.

With Virtual Office Angels, you get a team that’s a whiz at digital marketing. Think of making cool videos that show off what you’re all about. They use and manage your social media presence to talk to your customers in a way that feels genuine and design eye-catching graphics that make people stop scrolling and start clicking. This is how virtual assistants help your business create stories that get heard, remembered, and shared.

6.   Small Enterprises and Emerging Startups

Over 2.5 million businesses are operating in Australia, with thousands of them falling under small companies and emerging startups. Being quick on your feet and keeping things simple is crucial in making it big in this industry.

Virtual Office Angels is here to alleviate the burden on small enterprises and emerging startups. We handle time-consuming daily tasks such as managing emails, handling calls, and organising schedules. This liberation of time empowers business owners, enabling them to focus on strategic growth and improvement.

Virtual Office Angels helps Small to Medium Enterprises (SME) and emerging startups communicate effectively with their customers. We offer writing and editing services to help create compelling articles, blogs, and marketing materials. This is highly critical and important in marketing because it helps attract and keep customers by speaking directly to what they need and want, enhancing customer engagement.

Conclusion: A Partner for Growth Across Industries

Virtual Office Angel’s comprehensive suite of virtual assistant (VA) services caters to various industries, offering specialised support that aligns with each sector’s unique demands. By partnering with the right virtual assistant, businesses in Australia can leverage expert assistance to streamline their operations, enhance their digital presence, and ultimately drive significant growth.

Whether you’re in real estate, finance, digital marketing, or technology, Virtual Office Angels’ virtual assistants (VAs) are equipped to propel your business to new heights.
